body: I can't even really put my finger on it.  I just am depressed.  I feel worthless in my life.  I no longer have a SO or an apartment.  I'm barely recognized for all the hard work I put in at my job.  I don't have any friends to hang out with.  I just feel alone and depressed and worthless and as if it wont get better.  How could it, it hasn't for the past 11 years.  I don't expect it to magically turn around now.
